mapper.select: WITH tablecomments AS ( SELECT c.relname AS table_name , 'Table' AS table_type , obj_description(c.oid) AS comments FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c INNER JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON c.relnamespace = n.oid INNER JOIN pg_tables d ON c.relname = d.tablename WHERE c.relkind = 'r' AND nspname = 'public' ), viewcomments AS ( SELECT table_name , 'View' AS table_type , '' AS comments FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.views WHERE table_schema = 'public' ) SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY table_name) AS table_id , table_name AS table_name , comments AS table_comments , 'PUBLIC' AS tablespace_name , table_type AS table_type FROM ( SELECT * FROM tablecomments UNION ALL SELECT * FROM viewcomments ) A WHERE 1 = 1 AND upper(A.table_name) LIKE upper(#{tableName}) ORDER BY table_name

WITH tabledesc AS ( SELECT c.ordinal_position AS column_id , c.column_name AS column_name , CASE data_type WHEN 'character varying' THEN 'Varchar' WHEN 'timestamp without time zone' THEN 'Date' WHEN 'numeric' THEN 'Number' WHEN 'text' THEN 'Text' ELSE data_type END AS data_type , pgd.description AS column_comment , CASE is_nullable WHEN 'NO' THEN 'Not Null' ELSE '' END AS null_able , c.character_maximum_length AS column_length , upper(c.table_name) AS table_name FROM pg_catalog.pg_statio_all_tables AS st INNER JOIN pg_catalog.pg_description pgd ON (pgd.objoid = st.relid) INNER JOIN information_schema.columns c ON (pgd.objsubid = c.ordinal_position AND c.table_schema = st.schemaname AND c.table_name = st.relname) ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position ) SELECT * FROM tabledesc WHERE table_name = upper(#{tableName}) ORDER BY table_name, column_id
